description:
The InventoryManager app is failing to compile because the 'Item' data object is being passed via Intent but does not implement the Parcelable interface. 

Your task is to:
1. Enable the 'kotlin-parcelize' plugin in the app's build.gradle.kts file.
2. Modify 'app/src/main/java/com/example/inventory/model/Item.kt' to annotate the data class with '@Parcelize' and implement the 'android.os.Parcelable' interface.
3. Verify the fix by building the project successfully.
